notes: Posted 19 November 2001, before Theed Palace, so the format is Premiere - Reflections III.

Starting cards as posted under 'start8': Bring Him Before Me ('BHBM'), Your Destiny ('your daddy'), Insignificant Rebellion, Death Star II: Throne Room ('ds2throneroom') — the objective's required deploys — plus Prepared Defenses ('prep def') and the three Effects it starts: Colo Claw Fish, Crush The Rebellion and You Cannot Hide Forever. All count toward the total. No Fear Is My Ally or Defensive Shields are posted.
Section headers with counts ('start8', 'locations3', 'characters18', etc.) are not cards.
The list totals 59 as published: the Interrupts header says 19 but lists 20, and the section headers add to 58; kept as posted.
Posted 'EPP maul' dested Darth Maul With Lightsaber, a Theed Palace card (Theed Palace was released 12 December 2001, after this post).

Posted 'expensive palpatine' dested Emperor Palpatine (the objective lets the Emperor deploy from Reserve Deck; the strategy deploys him there); 'sim shady' Sim Aloo; 'dannik y2j' Dannik Jerriko (the strategy: 'dannik OOP jedi'); 'upkeep boba' Boba Fett, Bounty Hunter (the Boba with a maintenance cost); 'iggy with gun' IG-88 With Riot Gun; 'marajade' Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand; 'mara stick' Mara Jade's Lightsaber.
Posted '4lom' dested 4-LOM (the plain card; the list names the 'with gun' versions when it means them, e.g. 'iggy with gun').
Posted 'holotable' dested the Dark site Imperial Holotable (the strategy fetches it with Masterful Move); 'blockade bridge' / 'blockade hallway' Blockade Flagship: Bridge / Hallway.

Posted 'blowjob parried' dested the Dark interrupt Blow Parried (for the Light deck 19965 the same author's nickname dested Strike Blocked); 'combo move' Masterful Move & Endor Occupation; 'combo evader' Evader & Monnok; 'holonet trans' HoloNet Transmission; 'you are beaten down' You Are Beaten; 'we must accelerate our flagship' We Must Accelerate Our Plans; 'foil force lightning' Force Lightning.
Posted 'colo clawfish' and 'disarmed' dested the Dark printings Colo Claw Fish (Dark) and Disarmed (Dark).
Posted 'no escape (from s&m)' dested the Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck Effect No Escape (posted among the Effects in the 60, so not the Reflections III Defensive Shield).
Posted 's&m' matches no card we could identify; printed as written.

Byline 'Haakon ".prototype." Geburtstag' looks like a joke name (Geburtstag is German for birthday; the post is signed 'giles'), so the deck is credited to the handle .prototype. with no player page, as with decks 19835 and 19965.
